utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Not yet — I’ll check with the group and let you know what everyone wants to read next.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you confirm it once the group decides? I want to know for sure before I plan on it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll confirm it as soon as the group decides.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still checking the date and time, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — send it over when you have it, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — I appreciate that. I’ll send the details as soon as I confirm the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good — let’s choose the book and a date first. What are you leaning toward?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m leaning toward a warm, easy read with a little discussion spark — I can send a couple options soon, and we can pick the date from there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds perfect, Mara — send the options when you’re ready, and I’ll help us pick a date once we’ve chosen the book.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did Oren reply about the book yet, or are we still waiting on the group message?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I’m still waiting on the group message—Leo said he’d ask everyone, and I keep forgetting the details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, I’ll wait for the group message too—just send me the time once Leo confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We’re doing a mystery novel this month—nice and twisty. I’ll send over the title and time once I grab my notes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — send it over when you have your notes, and I’ll help repeat the title and time so everyone stays on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate that. I’ll grab my notes and send you the title and time soon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s still "The Night Circus," if that works for you. I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that works — "The Night Circus" sounds like a lively pick. I’ll pass that along and let you know as soon as the book club’s timing is firm.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. Just let me know when the time’s set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I didn’t catch the group message either, but I heard it might be the mystery pick. Did Eli see the update?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes — it’s a mystery this month, and we meet next Tuesday evening in the community room. If you want, I can tell you the title and our usual start time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, yes please — what’s the title and what time do we usually start?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m leaning toward something easy and fun, maybe a short mystery, and next Thursday works for me. Then we can fill in the rest pretty quickly.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — next Thursday works, and a short mystery should keep things fun. I’ll see you in the community room at 7, and bring the books along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, 7 in the community room works for me. I’ll be there and we can sort the rest then.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check the plan first—are we still meeting at my place? If so, I can handle the space and you can bring the snacks.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that works for me — your place is perfect. I’ll bring the snacks and setup, and I may run a little late, so a reminder would help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely — I’ll send a reminder and keep things ready at my place. What time should I plan for?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks — sweet and savory both would be great, and I’ll bring the bookmarks and extra cups.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Lovely, Cleo — I’ve got sweet and savory noted, along with the bookmarks and extra cups. We’re set for next Thursday at 6 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Opal — I’ll see you both next Thursday at 6.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect—just send me the Thursday after-school time when you have it, and I’ll plan around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think I missed the update, but I’ll check on the Thursday time and send it over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah — I appreciate it. Just let me know once you confirm the Thursday time, and I’ll work around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the book club details and a reminder so you don’t miss it!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, thanks Quinn — I’ll keep an eye out for the details and reminder.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll send over the details soon and a reminder before Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ve got the cups covered, so we’re just set on tea and the snacks now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh perfect, thanks, Cleo — that’s one less thing to worry about. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear whether we’re definitely on for tonight.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks — just keep me posted, and I’ll bring the snacks for tonight.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s going alright—still pretty low-key, but the mystery pick should liven it up. I’ll send you the title and time as soon as I grab my notes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Ira — just send me the title and time when you have them, and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m running errands now, but I’ll dig out my notes and send it over soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I didn’t see it—what did the group message say?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not totally sure either—I think it might’ve been the mystery one, but I’d want to double-check the group message.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—I'll check the group message. If it is the mystery one, that works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the title and start time, but I’d love to hear them when you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ll let you know the title and start time as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. I’m looking forward to hearing the details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — book club is this Thursday at 7 at the community center, and we’re discussing "The Lark and the Lantern." I’ll send you a reminder so you don’t miss it!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, thanks — Thursday at 7 works for me. I’ll come by and look for your reminder.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll send the reminder closer to Thursday — looking forward to seeing you at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — Thursdays after school still work for me. Just send the time when you’ve confirmed it, and I’ll plan around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure thing — I’ll confirm the time and send it along once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Eli — I appreciate it. I’ll keep Thursday after school open and plan around pickup once you send the time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, thanks for the reminder—was it still "The Night Circus"? I’m happy to help, just let me know the time and place again.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’s the one, yes — I can check the time and place again. Thanks for helping with the book club!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, wonderful—thanks, Sam. Just let me know when you’ve got it, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check the plan first—are we still meeting at my place? If so, I can handle the space and you can bring the snacks.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still sorting out the details—can you confirm the time and where you want me to bring the snacks?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking the exact time, but yes, please bring the snacks to my place. I’ll confirm the time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — send me the details and a reminder, and I’ll do my best to make it on time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll send the book and date once we pick them, plus a reminder before then.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Bo — appreciate it. I’ll handle snacks and setup, and I’ll try not to be too late.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh yeah, I still need to check what they picked — I must’ve missed that update. I’ll let you know as soon as I find out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — just send it my way when you have it, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Will do — I’ll check and send it over as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m on it—I’ll send over a couple of book options soon and follow up with the Thursday time once I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Mara — send the options when you can, and I’ll check with the group.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do—I’ll send the book options soon and keep everyone posted on the Thursday time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do we have a confirmed time yet, or is the book club still tentative tonight?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We have a tentative time in mind — next Thursday at 6 at the community center. If that works for you, I can mark it as our plan.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm that’s definitely set, or is it still tentative? I just want to know whether I should plan on showing up.
